name: Getsuei Gakuen -ergO-
source:
Mitsuki Eiri entered Getsuei Academy to search for her missing brother.

That night, she encountered a form called The Hazard.

The students of Getsuei face an evil demon in the form of a human.
What darkness awaits... 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE088389.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
御月英理为了寻找失踪的哥哥，进入月英学园就读。

当晚，她遭遇了名为“Hazard”的异形。

月英学园的学生们将面对披着人类外皮的邪魔。
等待他们的，究竟是怎样的黑暗……
